title: Japan Couple Odyssey
headline: Tokyo nights, a Hakone onsen, then Kyoto’s quieter lanes.
description: Seven nights for two: Tokyo, a Hakone pause, then Kyoto — paced for walking, not ticking lists.
image_alt: Kiyomizu-dera Temple with cherry blossoms in Kyoto
price_label: Quoted for your hotels and rail
price_guidance: Japan pricing depends on hotel category, season — cherry blossom and autumn command more — and whether a JR Pass still suits your route. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s first Japan without a tour-bus timetable. Three nights in Tokyo for neighbourhoods and evenings, one night in Hakone for onsen and a Fuji view if the weather allows, then Kyoto for temples and Gion after dark.
highlights: Three nights in Tokyo — one neighbourhood as your base.
A Hakone night with onsen access as the ryokan offers it.
Three nights in Kyoto for Fushimi Inari or Arashiyama at a sane hour.
Shinkansen or reserved rail as quoted.
why: Cities and one mountain pause, without covering the whole country.
Vegetarian dining can be researched restaurant by restaurant.
Visa guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.
inclusions: Airport transfer in Tokyo as quoted
Breakfast where the hotel includes it
Hakone stay with selected meals if it is a ryokan plan
exclusions: Japan visa fees if they apply
IC cards, local metro, temple tickets and tea ceremony unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
